name: 0G Labs
rootCause: 0G reported a rewards-contract drain on December 11, 2025 involving its emergency withdrawal capability. The project-attributed account describes a cloud compromise exposing a locally stored key and reports losses of 520,010 0G, 9.93 ETH, and 4,200 USDT. The project-attributed account describes exposure of privileged signing authority through compromised cloud infrastructure, followed by emergency withdrawal from a rewards contract. The contract's exact authorization implementation and the withdrawal transactions remain unresolved.
